entities.name: Query glycerol-3-P dehydrogenase
observations: The 332-residue query sequence exactly matches curated UniProt entry B1M7L6 at 100% identity and full-length coverage.
Pfam domains NAD_Gly3P_dh_N (PF01210) and NAD_Gly3P_dh_C (PF07479) support the glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase fold.
The enzyme is annotated as cytosolic glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+], EC 1.1.1.94.

entities.name: DHAP to glycerol-3-P
observations: Catalyzed reduction: dihydroxyacetone phosphate + NAD(P)H + H+ → sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + NAD(P)+.
The reverse oxidative direction is sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + NAD(P)+ → dihydroxyacetone phosphate + NAD(P)H + H+; database mappings include Rhea RHEA:11092 and RHEA:11096.
The reaction supplies sn-glycerol 3-phosphate for glycerophospholipid biosynthesis.

entities.name: GPDH sequence properties
observations: Query length is 332 aa; predicted molecular weight is 32.70 kDa; theoretical pI is 7.84.
Sequence-derived properties are computational estimates and do not establish kinetics or cofactor preference independently.
